    // The generalized golden ratio of the given dimension: the positive root of
    // x^(d + 1) = x + 1. One gives the golden ratio, two the plastic number
    // 1.3247..., three the R3 constant 1.2207... Computed rather than tabulated,
    // so the identity that defines it is what a reader sees.
    // Precondition: dimensions is at least one — the derivative Newton divides by
    // vanishes below that.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Plastic_ratio
